lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern along the mid-lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular centroids to form a lattice-like structure across the mid-section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Distinct horizontal linear feature running along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and a shadow-defined margin below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs visible on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, primarily clustered towards the anterior and mid-sections of the fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, irregular high-luminance patch located on the dorsal-lateral surface posterior to the first dorsal fin, consistent with localized tissue trauma or depigmented scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced transition in spot morphology from small, high-density pixel clusters on the cephalic region to larger, lower-density clusters on the posterior trunk.
